description: A Project's `.coding-owl.yaml`, or the `config.yaml` under its directory in the configuration home. See https://github.com/vojtechmares/coding-owl#project-configuration.

account.description: The Account this Project's Jobs run on.

allowedTools.description: What an unattended Agent may do without asking.

branchPrefix.description: What a Job's branch is named under. The default is `owl/`.

budgetUSD.description: What this Project's Jobs may spend. A spend cap cannot be negative.

checks.description: The Verification checks that judge a Run's work. All run, and every failure is reported.

expect.description: What the check's success looks like. The default is exit zero.

name.description: What the check is called, unique within the Project.

timeout.description: The longest this check may run, like `10m`.

maxParallelRuns.description: How many Runs may go at once. At least one; stopping the daemon is how nothing runs.

phases.description: What each phase of a Job runs as, and how long it may take.

effort.description: How hard this phase thinks, like `xhigh`.

model.description: What this phase runs as, like `anthropic/claude-opus`. `owl models` lists them.

stall.description: The longest this phase's Agent may go without saying anything, like `15m`.

timeout.description: The longest this phase's Agent may run at all, like `4h`.

effort.description: How hard this phase thinks, like `xhigh`.

model.description: What this phase runs as, like `anthropic/claude-opus`. `owl models` lists them.

stall.description: The longest this phase's Agent may go without saying anything, like `15m`.

timeout.description: The longest this phase's Agent may run at all, like `4h`.

setup.description: Shell commands preparing each fresh worktree before an Agent starts.

skills.description: The Skills Owl fetches and pins for this Project's Agents.

auto_update.description: Whether Owl moves the pin when the ref does.

git.description: The repository the Skill comes from, like `owner/repo`.

ref.description: The ref to pin it to.

unattendedClauses.description: Appended to Owl's standing unattended contract for this Project.

verification.description: Verification beyond the Project's own checks.

agent.description: Additionally have a fresh Agent review the diff.

timeout.description: The longest the reviewing Agent may take.

title: Coding Owl project configuration
